code.text: COAG
PANEL.MICRO

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia and acidemia (low pH, low O2 saturation, low pO2), mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and elevated D-dimer, ferritin, LDH, and INR, suggesting significant inflammation and possible coagulopathy. Liver enzymes are low, and total protein is slightly decreased. No evidence of acute myocardial injury or COVID-19 infection. Findings are consistent with severe hypoxic respiratory failure and systemic inflammation; clinical correlation and urgent evaluation are recommended.
